description.from: Move runtime data.events into a RecordLake; keep reading the old embedded form as a fallback during migration. Depends on S1.
description.to:
Move the step-by-step runtime events out of the runtime journals into a record lake (98.7% of the per-publication files).
Acceptance: one-worker-at-a-time (owner and fence) protections preserved in the small status note; never-pay-twice unaffected; reads fall back to the old embedded form during migration; contract specs on every backend. Depends on S1.
